4.12 Deficit financing at the macroeconomic level to support increased health

expenditure is a very unattractive option in Vanuatu and is not recommended. There are

several reasons for this position. Prudent deficit financing is appropriate for investments that

generate returns greater than the cost of borrowing, or to make up shortfalls in private
